preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly three lines.
N and M are integers within the range [1, 200000].
The arrays A and B have lengths N and M respectively.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= x <= 10**9 for x in A) and all(-10**9 <= x <= 10**9 for x in B)
preconditions.description: All elements in A and B are integers within the range [-10^9, 10^9].

postconditions.expression: isinstance(stdout.strip(), str) and stdout.strip().isdigit() or (stdout.strip().startswith('-') and stdout.strip()[1:].isdigit())
postconditions.description: The output is a single integer string representing the minimum number of swaps.

The output integer equals the minimum total swaps achievable by optimally reordering A and B before processing, where min_swaps is the sum of swaps required for each element of B when inserted into the evolving array A according to the specified bubble-up rule.
